english_translation: With the exhaustion of the taints, an individual, having personally experienced in this life directly knowing by himself the liberation of the mind without taints, liberation by wisdom, dwells having reached [this state].

english_translation: “All things are governed by mindfulness, all things have understanding as (their) highest, all things have liberation as [their] core, all things are plunged into the deathless, all things are culminating in extinguishment.”
